newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Spectrum Info FY 1997 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Spectrum Info FY 1997 oper loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Spectrum Information Technologies Inc reported an operating loss of $3.97 million for the fiscal year ended March 31, 1997 compared to operating income of $577,000 during the previous fiscal year. It did not release the operating earnings share on a per share basis.
Net income includes Chapter 11 administrative expenses which totalled $2.3 million in 1997 and $3.5 million in 1996.

Net income includes the loss from continuing operations of $5.9 million or $5.78 a share in 1997 and $1.12 million or $1.13 a share in 1996. Net also includes earnings from discontinued operations of $531,000 or $0.52 in 1997 and earned $4.1 million or $4.01 a share in 1998.
The 1997 period also includes the loss on extinguishment of debt of $800,000 or $0.78 a share.
Spectrum's 1996 fiscal year revenues include a $6 million license fee as part of a pact to settle arbitration.
Spectrum paid $3.3 million to its unsecured and priority creditors, representing full payment of their claims plus interest, in connection with a March 31, 1997 reorganization.
Spectrum paid $250,000 and $6.4 million in stock as part of a settlement of a 1993 securities related class action.
